LanguageData.YDM.Settings.SmartRaiders: Sapper and breacher raids follow you down the shaft
LanguageData.YDM.Settings.SmartRaidersDesc: When no active colonists are on the surface but some are underground, raiders using the sapper or breacher strategy climb down the shaft once they can reach it. Other raiders never notice the underground levels.
LanguageData.YDM.Settings.ShaftInvulnerableDesc: Mine shafts take no damage. A destroyed shaft collapses every level below it, so turn this on if you don't want to risk losing them in a raid. You can still seal them.
LanguageData.YDM.Settings.DebugLogDesc: Logs what colonists found when checking other levels for work and needs, and hauling decisions. Turn on only when tracking down a problem.
LanguageData.YDM.RemoteNoOptions: The colonists selected on another level have nothing they can do here
LanguageData.YDM.Settings.ProfilerDesc: Shows, above the level panel, how much time (ms) and how many calls this mod used per category over the last second, and logs it every 10 seconds. Nested categories count only their own share.
LanguageData.YDM.Perf.Title: Deep Mining: {0} ms per second
LanguageData.YDM.CollapseDesc: Collapse the shaft and seal it. Every level below disappears: everything there is lost and every person and animal still down there is crushed.
LanguageData.YDM.CollapseConfirm: Really seal this shaft? {0} and every level below it will collapse. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.YDM.CollapseConfirmPawns: {0} colonists and {1} other creatures are still down there. They will all be crushed.
LanguageData.YDM.CollapsedLetterText: The mine shaft caved in. {0} and every level below it are gone.
LanguageData.YDM.RaidersDescending: Raiders from {0} are climbing down the mine shaft!
LanguageData.YDM.MaxDepthReached: Can't dig any deeper (maximum depth: level {0})
LanguageData.YDM.OneShaftPerMap: This map already has a mine shaft
LanguageData.YDM.AssignDesc: Choose the level this colonist mainly stays on. They stay there, but when there is nothing to do on it and there is work on another level connected by the shaft, they climb the ladders to go and do it, then come back once idle. If they get hungry or tired with no food or bed on that level, they go up.\n\nFree: no home level; they stay wherever their work took them.
LanguageData.YDM.LayerPanelMoveTip: Drag to move the panel. Right-click: back to the default spot
LanguageData.YDM.LayerPanelTip: Click to view that level. Selected colonists stay remote-selected, so you can right-click on this level to give them orders; they climb the ladders and carry them out on arrival.\n\nHotkeys: level above {0}, level below {1}
LanguageData.YDM.RemoteMoveHere: Come up/down the ladders and go here
LanguageData.YDM.RemoteMenuTitleMulti: {0} colonists (other level: carried out on arrival)
